info.text:
In September 2021, moving one 40-foot container cost a record $10,377 on Drewry's World Container Index, more than seven times the 2019 average. This video follows a box from factory to doorstep, explains just-in-time versus just-in-case, and charts the New York Fed's Global Supply Chain Pressure Index. It covers the 2021 chip shortage, the Ever Given, Red Sea detours, the 2023 Panama Canal drought and the 2026 Strait of Hormuz disruption, then works through a hypothetical example of freight cost per pair of sneakers and how Mexico became the top US goods trading partner in 2023.
